exposure: Surgical techniques used for uterine closure in previous cesarean delivery
surgical techniques used in previous cesarean delivery
outcome: Ultrasonography signs of placenta percreta (loss of the clear zone, placental lacunae, subplacental hypervascularity)
cohort: Pregnancies with placenta percreta managed between January 1, 2002, and March 31, 2017, at Saint Luc University Hospital, Brussels, Belgium
finding: The prenatal ultrasonography diagnosis of placenta percreta is accurate and facilitates optimal management by a specialized multidisciplinary team.
mod_finding: There was no difference between the groups in the surgical techniques used for previous cesarean deliveries.
